guides.title: Healthy Dog Poop: What Good Poop Looks Like, and What Poop Color Means
guides.description: What healthy dog poop looks like, and what texture and color (gray, black, bloody, green) can mean, including diarrhea color and when to see a vet.

guides.title: How Often Should a Dog Poop? Daily Potty Count and Intervals
guides.description: How many times a day puppies, adult and senior dogs poop, what a normal potty interval is, and when to talk to a vet.

guides.title: How to Track Potty for a Dog Who Only Goes Outside
guides.description: With an outdoor-only dog, only the walker knows if they went. Log it right after the walk and share it with your family in the app.

guides.title: Jindo Mix Potty Training: Why Does It Feel So Hard?
guides.description: Jindo mixes are smart and independent, so knowing their outdoor potty pattern matters most. Breed traits, training tips and how to keep a log.

guides.title: What Is a Dog Walk Safety Index? Is It Safe to Walk Today?
guides.description: Check if today's walk is safe on a 1 to 5 scale from feels-like temperature, chance of rain and your dog's size, age and coat. Plus summer and winter tips.

guides.title: Two Working Parents? How to Never Miss a Dog Walk or Mix Up Whose Turn It Is
guides.description: For dual-income homes: keep dog walk times on track and stop mixing up whose turn it is by seeing who walked the dog and when.

guides.title: How to Share Your Dog's Potty Log with Family in Real Time
guides.description: Skip the chat screenshots and notes. Share your dog's poop, pee and walk records with the whole family in real time, with one tap in the free POOPIEMATE app.

guides.title: Raising Multiple Dogs? How to Keep Their Potty Logs Straight
guides.description: In a multi-dog home it's easy to lose track of whose poop is whose. Log each dog in its own profile and share it with your family.
